product: Monitor and cap external provider costs
tagline: Unity Gateway can now track and cap spend on external model providers, such as Amazon Bedrock and Azure AI Foundry, not just Databricks provided models.
what_it_does: Unity Gateway can now track and cap spend on external model providers, such as Amazon Bedrock and Azure AI Foundry, not just Databricks provided models. If your organization already has capacity commitments directly with a provider, Unity Gateway becomes the single point to track that usage and enforce spend limits across teams and use cases. To turn it on, enable External Model Spend in Budgets (Beta) on the account console Previews page, then select Include external model usage when you create a budget scoped to the Unity Gateway resource type.
why_it_matters: Account and workspace admins can view a summary of AI budget status and spend on the AI page in Governance Hub.
